SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    ProductSubcategoryName,
    online_sales_amount
FROM
(
    SELECT
        c.ProductCategoryName,
        s.ProductSubcategoryName,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS online_sales_amount,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.ProductCategoryKey
            ORDER BY sum(f.SalesAmount) DESC, s.ProductSubcategoryName
        ) AS rn
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS s
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS c
        ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY
        c.ProductCategoryKey,
        c.ProductCategoryName,
        s.ProductSubcategoryName
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY ProductCategoryName
